messages.subject: lightweight graphics
parts:
Hi all. Thank you for shiny - I can't get enough of it :)

I generally make use of ggplot2 in producing graphs for shiny apps. ggplot2 is not necessarily made for the web though, so I was wondering if anybody has some perspective on other graphics packages that maybe use less CPU to generate graphics.

rCharts seems like a possibility, but I don't have any idea how to compare the processing output of ggplot to rCharts in terms of CPU really without learning rCharts - was hoping someone could point me in the right direction.

Dan
